name: labelled-diagram
description: A small architecture diagram, boxes joined by arrows, with each part named by a pointing label.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: right, left or both: where the labels stand

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: where the boxes' centre goes; labels are laid out there

returns: VGroup with .nodes, .arrows, .labels (leaders: each has .dot .line .label), .labels.grow() the animation that points out every part
